title: Decision: HMAC Final must hard-fail (WC_HW_E) if device unavailable, not CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE
description: crypto2dev_hmac():L1096-1104. When IOC_INIT fails at Final time after SETKEY already claimed the key, the code promotes NOT_COMPILED_IN to WC_HW_E and does NOT return CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE. This is correct: SETKEY returns 0 (claims the key), so wolfSSL skips its software ipad/opad key schedule. A software-fallback Final would compute HMAC with an all-zero key and return success — a silent authentication bypass. A future contributor seeing 'if NOT_COMPILED_IN -> return WC_HW_E' may think this is a missed fallback and 'fix' it to CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE. Do not change. The comment explains this but it is non-obvious and worth recording as a decision.
